title: Security Deposit Schedule for Wayfare Rentals Vehicle Classes
content:
Every Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals) agreement holds a security deposit, taken at pickup. The amount depends on the vehicle class; the release period and the order of application are the same for every class.

| Vehicle class | Deposit held at pickup | Release period after the return date | Order of application at return |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan | $250.00 | 7 calendar days | Unpaid balance first, the rest released |
| Wayfare Rentals Hybrid Sedan | $250.00 | 7 calendar days | Unpaid balance first, the rest released |
| Wayfare Rentals Electric Sedan | $250.00 | 7 calendar days | Unpaid balance first, the rest released |
| Wayfare Rentals Midsize SUV | $250.00 | 7 calendar days | Unpaid balance first, the rest released |
| Wayfare Rentals Minivan | $300.00 | 7 calendar days | Unpaid balance first, the rest released |
| Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan | $500.00 | 7 calendar days | Unpaid balance first, the rest released |

Footnotes to the schedule:

1. The release period is the number of calendar days after the return date by which the remaining deposit is released.
2. At return, the deposit is applied to the unpaid balance first and the rest is released.
3. The deposit is a separate account from the rental balance: it stands at the deposit held less any amounts released or applied.

Hypothetical reading: a Wayfare Rentals Minivan returned with no unpaid balance has $300.00 held, nothing to apply, and the full $300.00 remaining to be released within 7 calendar days of the return date.
